headline: Technical Lead
tagline: Leading Engineers. Building Design Systems. Delivering at Scale.
description: I'm a Technical Lead. That tagline above ☝️ is brought to you by Claude 🤖.

I build Design Systems with Design Tokens, and I've led teams throughout my career. I love enabling the Creators, Consumers, and Contributors of Design Systems to do their best work, and I'm at my best when I'm setting direction, mentoring engineers, and building teams. I also use AI-assisted development daily.
Arriving here hasn't been a straightforward journey. It's been 17 years of software development, the last 8 in frontend and design systems. See how I got here below 👇.
